question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is **"Condolance."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **'Condolence.'** • **'Condolence'** means an expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of a death. (सहानुभूति की अभिव्यक्ति, विशेषकर मृत्यु के अवसर पर) • **Example**: *My **condolences**__ are with you.* • It is a noun and pronounced as **kuh n-doh-luh ns**. • The word is derived from the Latin word **'condolere'**, which means to suffer with. • The correct answer is Option 3 . [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Irrelevant) **means not connected with or relevant to something. (किसी वस्‍तु से असंबद्घ या उसके लिए महत्वहीन, अप्रासंगिक, असंबद्घ) • **Option 2 (Miniature) **means something that is very small, especially a detailed replica of something. (बड़े आकार की वस्‍तु का लघु रूप) • **Option 4 (Millennium) **means a period of a thousand years. (एक हजार वर्ष की अवधि; सहस्‍त्राब्‍दी) 3b:T493, The correct answer is **"No substitution."**
